title: reprocess-document command payload

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command reprocess-document (admin design §4.7): re-runs one document from fromStage with a new execution id, bypassing the stage caches from there on (engine design §8); fetch re-fetches, later stages start from the stored content. Dedup reprocess:{documentId}.
